title: Infinite Backpack script
features:
Keybind: V -> you cant move after
Join a game, farm a lot of items, leave or tp to a blender interaction, rejoin or exit the interaction, and you should be able to move
or simply during the blending animation
script:
getgenv().zone = 10 --change this to the latest zone you have unlocked

function EmptyBackpack()

local plot
for i,v in pairs(game.Workspace.Plots:GetChildren()) do
if (v.PlotOwner.Value == game.Players.LocalPlayer.Name) then
plot = v
end
end

local blender
for i,v in pairs(plot.PlacedItems.Blenders:GetChildren()) do
blender = v
break
end

local args = {
    [1] = blender.BlendMenuOpener
}

game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.ScreenGui.BlenderMenu.Blend_Menu:FireServer(unpack(args))
end



function getItems()
   local before = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
   for i,v in pairs(game.Workspace.Areas:GetChildren()) do
      if (v.Area_Lvl.Value == getgenv().zone) then
         for a,b in pairs(v.Items:GetChildren()) do
            game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = b.Hitbox.CFrame
            wait(.1)
         end
      end
   end
   running = false
   game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = before
   EmptyBackpack()
end

        running = false
        while (wait(.1)) do
                if running then
                    getItems()
                end
        mouse = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
        mouse.KeyDown:connect(
            function(key)
                key = string.lower(key)
                if key == "v" then
                    running = true
                end
            end
        )
        end
